description: This Java class, PersistableProductOptionPopulator, is responsible for converting a PersistableProductOption object into a ProductOption object. It populates the product option details including descriptions and language-specific information, using services like LanguageService, as part of the data transformation layer in a web application.

classes.name: PersistableProductOptionPopulator
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractDataPopulator to convert PersistableProductOption objects into ProductOption objects, handling descriptions and language logic.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts a PersistableProductOption into a ProductOption, setting properties and descriptions based on the source data and the provided language.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method, but currently returns null, indicating instantiation is handled elsewhere or needs implementation.

methods.name: setLanguageService
methods.description: Injects or sets the LanguageService instance used for language lookups.
